exposure: Interventions for the treatment of pregnant women with pregestational diabetes mellitus
cohort: The study participants were 205 international stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, researchers, and women with pregestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: The study developed a Core Outcome Set (COS) consisting of 19 key outcomes for randomised controlled trials evaluating interventions for pregnant women with pregestational diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: Mode of birth was included as one of the 19 core outcomes in the developed Core Outcome Set.
